extraction_method: AST-isolated actual FastMCP registration: copied exact tool decorators, signatures, defaults and docstrings plus required constant/server assignments into a local module; replaced implementation bodies with inert returns; obtained schemas with FastMCP.list_tools(). No tool calls executed. Runtime mcp 1.30.0, Pydantic 2.13.5.
limitations: Repository specifies mcp>=1.2.0 and unpinned dependencies; introspected with installed mcp 1.30.0/Pydantic 2.13.5, so another dependency version may emit different incidental schema details.
Full server import was unavailable because pandas is not installed; AST isolation preserves every registration-relevant element and avoids provider/web runtime imports.
Schemas and implementation verified from source; live Google Trends/provider behavior was not exercised.
reason: Four unconditional actual MCP registrations and complete input schemas established; three Trends execution tools and one task-status management tool. Async stdio database initialization caveat is recorded.

tools.name: compare_keywords
tools.description: 对比最多 5 个关键词在 Google Trends 上的时间序列热度。
tools.behavior: Fetches Google Trends interest-over-time via configured trendspy (default) or pytrends provider, optionally removes partial rows, returns rows, Markdown table, summary, and metadata.
validation_notes: Input schema has no keyword count/item-length bounds, geo pattern, timeframe enum, or TTL bounds; these must not be inferred from prose.
Implementation strips timeframe and requires nonempty value; geo is stripped/uppercased and must be empty or match [A-Z0-9-]+.
Rate limits are enabled only via GOOGLE_TRENDS_MCP_RATE_LIMIT; compare is 10/60s, research and async share 5/3600s.
Keywords are trimmed, blank entries removed, case-insensitively deduplicated; resulting count must be 1–5.

tools.name: research_keywords
tools.description: 多关键词批量调研，支持最多 50 个关键词，使用 anchor 关键词进行跨批次归一化。
tools.behavior: Fetches up to 50 cleaned keywords in batches sharing an anchor, normalizes cross-batch metrics against anchor baseline, and returns metrics, rankings, batches, Markdown, summary, metadata and cache statistics.
validation_notes: Input schema has no keyword count/item-length bounds, geo pattern, timeframe enum, or TTL bounds; these must not be inferred from prose.
Implementation strips timeframe and requires nonempty value; geo is stripped/uppercased and must be empty or match [A-Z0-9-]+.
Rate limits are enabled only via GOOGLE_TRENDS_MCP_RATE_LIMIT; compare is 10/60s, research and async share 5/3600s.

Keywords are trimmed, blank entries removed, case-insensitively deduplicated; resulting count must be 1–50. Anchor defaults to first cleaned keyword; a nonempty new anchor is appended and must fit within the 50-keyword limit.
cache_ttl_seconds is an unconstrained integer; no positive-value validation is implemented.

tools.name: research_keywords_async
tools.description: 提交批量调研任务，立即返回 task_id。适用于 5+ 关键词的长任务。
tools.behavior: Normalizes research keywords, persists a pending SQLite task, submits the same research implementation to a background executor, and immediately returns task_id, pending status, estimated_seconds and keyword_count.
validation_notes: Same research keyword/anchor normalization and 1–50 implementation count limit as research_keywords.
Timeframe and geo validation happens in the background research task after submission, not before returning task_id.
cache_ttl_seconds is an unconstrained integer; no positive-value validation is implemented.
SQLite research_tasks schema is initialized by web lifespan only; plain stdio mode does not call init_database, so async tools require an already initialized database.

tools.name: get_research_task
tools.description: 查询异步调研任务的进度或拉取结果。
tools.behavior: Looks up a SQLite research task and returns status/progress, completed research result or failure error; unknown IDs return not_found.
validation_notes: task_id has no format or length restriction; lookup uses a SQL parameter.
No task ownership filter is present in this lookup.
SQLite research_tasks schema is initialized by web lifespan only; plain stdio mode requires an already initialized database.
